AspisR1.NJF_PairInstantiation.root.statement:

  NIT_PairDomain.Domain i.owner.value i.alpha.value i.message.value i.kappa →
    FIo_Native.weights.Weights.pair i.owner.value i.alpha.value.to_slice i.message.value i.kappa =

AspisR1.NJF_Root.finish.statement:
∀ (r : NP6_StdModel.Reservation) (loc : NIW_AlignFinishComposed.Locations)
  (proof : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (v : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.View) (p : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.Prepared)
  (a : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.Accumulator),
  NIG_FinishInput.Domain proof v p a →
    ∀ (port : NIT_Cuts.PairPort) (afterOwner : ℕ),
      NIW_AlignFinishPort.Cut p port afterOwner (NJF_FinishObserved.G r loc v p a).2.2 →
        have execution := NJF_FinishObserved.G r loc v p a;
        Port3_NativeFinishBody.verifier.finish_relation (NIG_Slots.installed r) v p a none = execution.1 ∧
          (∀ event ∈ execution.2.1, NIW_AlignFinishInvocation.Clause r event) ∧
            (∀ event ∈ execution.2.1, NIW_AlignFinishDomains.Inputs p v a event) ∧
              NIW_AlignFinishPrefix.Prefix execution.2.1 ∧
                NIW_AlignFinishPairCertificate.Bound r execution.2.2 ∧
                  NIW_AlignFinishInfoEvent.HasPair execution ∧
                    NIW_AlignFinishInfoNew.HasNew p execution ∧ NIW_AlignFinishPort.Bound r port execution.2.2
AspisR1.NJF_Root.finish.kind: deployed pair-and-finish positive hybrid certificate root
